evals.prompt: 审计当前 Scholium 发布是否达到要求；只报告，不修改任何文件。
evals.expected_output: Release-acceptance mode: follows the canonical specification manifest and declared release chapter, separates status from live evidence, and remains read-only.
assertions: Uses Docs/SCHOLIUM_SPEC.md and its declared release route rather than an undocumented release document.
Does not claim release, signing, UI, accessibility, or performance acceptance from a repository verifier alone.
Does not edit product code or developer skills.

evals.prompt: 修复当前索引实现里的一个局部排序错误；合同、存储和调用边界都不变。
evals.expected_output: Routes to scholium-derived-index-integrity alone rather than loading the whole-app auditor or repository engineering.
assertions: Recognizes the request as a bounded specialist-owned index issue.
Does not expand the task into architecture or whole-app release audit.

evals.prompt: 只诊断 Agent 修改 Note 时拒绝了当前有效 fingerprint 的问题；不要做全应用审计。
evals.expected_output: Routes the bounded Note mutation to scholium-agent-collaboration rather than the whole-app auditor.
assertions: Recognizes Note revision validation as a narrow functional owner.
Does not broaden one Note mutation into a whole-app audit.
Remains read-only because the request asks only for diagnosis.
